desc:
[🦋] BUILD your Butterfly Garden

🎃 Halloween Update Part 1 is here!

🦇 Haunted Plaza
Explore the haunted chapel, graveyard, pumpkins and a new river with bridges!

🥚 Pumpkin Egg
Find this rare egg and hatch 3 Shiny butterflies: Skeleton Jack, Doctor Dusk and Ghost Bride! Also rare in Butterfly Harvest.

🏚️ New Halloween Plot!

🎁 Halloween Crates
Earn them from Community Missions instead of Fairy Crates!
🥉 Tier 1: 50% Crate
🥈 Tier 2: 75% Crate
🥇 Tier 3: 100% Crate
8 limited decorations inside! Crates and their decorations can't be traded yet. Existing Fairy Crates can still be opened!

🕯️ 12 New Halloween Decorations
Available in the Plaza Shop!
Build the ultimate butterfly garden!

🥚 Hatch eggs!
🦋 Collect rare butterflies!
🐾 Unlock 6 unique pets to accompany you!
⛩️ Decorate your dream garden!
🌸 Upgrade flowerbeds for more nectar!
🏆 Collect Likes and climb the leaderboard!
⏳ Earn nectar while offline!

🎁 Join Chocolatine Games and rate the game for free rewards.
